_doc: «MilkDrop» (T4.3, docs/06 §7.3, copy of projectM/Kodi/Poweramp, docs/01a §B.2): 30 s per preset, 3 s soft blend, hard cuts off; a new preset by the vibe on a track change. Pick: nearest kept presets by descriptors (index.json), weights below; a random one of the closest `top_k`, not one of the last `recent`; ♥ draws a preset closer (distance × like), ✕ removes it.
